municipalities.source: Libyan Ministry of Local Government municipality directory

cities.source: Legacy public CitySeeder dataset from this repository

notes.english_names: Developer-friendly transliterations; not asserted to be official English spellings.
notes.municipalities_and_cities: Kept as separate datasets because municipality and city are not interchangeable concepts.
notes.map_points: Coordinates are sourced reference points. Null coordinates mean no sufficiently confident match is published.
notes.map_boundaries: Boundary GeoJSON is partial and must not be treated as complete legal or cadastral coverage.
